2027 Honda Civic Sedan and Hatchback Arrive in the US, New Sport-L Trim Will Start Below $28,500
7 photos
Photo: Honda
Since we’re deep within the fall season, American Honda is preoccupied with the 2027 model year novelties, and it recently announced the refreshed 2027 Honda Passport TrailSport mid-size SUV is making its way into dealerships now, plus the updated 2027 Honda Civic Type R gaining sharper performance and handling, new comfort features and technologies, and more.
Now it’s time to also see what’s new for the 2027 Honda Civic sedan and hatchback models, which are dubbed by the company as “America’s best-selling compact car” series. Indeed, American Honda posted its best September deliveries this year since 2020 as well as the best Q3 results since 2019.
Honda’s namesake brand surged by almost 18% in September 2026 to almost 112k units, reached over 358k vehicle deliveries during the third quarter of the year, up more than nine percentage points, and also surged almost five percent year-to-date with a total of 1,045,593 sales. During that time, the Civic series has surged by more than five percent to over 195k units over the past nine months.
As such, it’s no wonder that Honda is eager to bring it up to 2027 model year specifications and release it into showrooms as soon as possible. Called “sleek and fun-to-drive,” the 2027 Honda Civic series is arriving at nationwide dealerships now, complete with a new Sport-L trim level ready to join the range by the end of the year.
The 2027 Honda Civic Sedan pricing kicks off at an MSRP of $24,995 sans the $1,295 destination charge. That’s for the LX model, and the Sport begins at $26,995 while the new Sport-L is $28,495, all three featuring the 2.0-liter engine and CVT. The hybrid versions are Sport Hybrid and Sport Touring Hybrid, respectively, starting from $29,695 or $32,695.
Next up, the hatchback model is costlier: there are Sport, Sport-L, Sport Hybrid, and Sport Touring Hybrid versions from $28,195 through $33,895. Slotting between the Civic Sport and Sport Hybrid models, the first-ever Civic Sport-L comes with the leather upholstery from the Sport Touring Hybrid, heated front seats, power-adjustable front seats, dual-zone climate control, a passenger-side seatback pocket, vanity mirrors with illumination, and silver-colored interior trim, all previously exclusive to the hybrid or Sport Touring Hybrid models.
"Civic has earned its place as America's best-selling compact car1 by delivering the fun, efficiency and value that customers expect from Honda," said Luis Guerra, assistant vice president of Honda National Auto Sales at American Honda Motor Co., Inc. "With the new Civic Sport-L, we're making some of Civic's most desirable premium features more accessible, giving buyers another smart reason to choose Civic."
Additionally, the 2027 Civic Sport Touring Hybrid model gets the new Honda S+ Shift technology from the 2026 Honda Prelude, which “simulates a performance transmission for the ultimate electrified Honda driving experience, including virtual rev-matched downshifts and gear holding, plus enhanced engine sounds.”
